summary: Frontend testing of P0 Credits explanation strategy (Plume Astrale). Tested /credits public page, footer link, CreditsInfoModal wiring on ChatIA + MonCompte (banner + Crédits tab), Escape/close, stopPropagation, and V3 regression on Home, /theme-natal-luxe, /kabbale + GiftModal. All primary flows work. Only issue found: SEO title on /credits does not update (react-helmet-async not applying pageTitle).

ui_bugs.issue: Document title remains 'Plume Astrale | Guidance Symbolique Personnalisée — Astrologie & Tarot' instead of 'Comment fonctionnent les crédits — Plume Astrale'. Helmet title is set in /app/frontend/src/pages/CreditsInfo.js via <SEO title=...> but is not reflected in document.title after 3s wait. Likely a HelmetProvider/context issue or a global title override in the app. Impact: SEO/social share for /credits.

issues: React console warning: 'a style property during rerender...' related to borderBottom shorthand mixed with borderBottomColor. Cosmetic/dev-only warning, not user-facing.

verified_flows: /credits loads with Playfair hero 'Un crédit, une intention posée à Soléna.'
4 PACKS (Comète 7,99€, Nébuleuse 17,99€ [BEST], Constellation 34,99€, Voie Lactée 59,99€) present
3 promises rendered with data-testid=credits-promise-* (Sans expiration / engagement / mauvaise surprise)
credits-info-cta-buy Link href = /acheter-credits (redirects to /connexion when anonymous, expected)
chat-credits-help opens credits-info-overlay + credits-info-modal; Escape closes; credits-info-close closes
mon-compte-credits-help opens modal WITHOUT navigating to /acheter-credits (stopPropagation OK)
V3 regression OK on /, /theme-natal-luxe, /kabbale (nav + footer render, no page errors)
action_items: Fix /credits SEO title — verify <HelmetProvider> is wrapping the app root and no other component overrides document.title. Check if react-helmet-async is properly hydrated on public pages that use PsPageShell + SEO.
critical_code_review_comments: SEO title mismatch on /credits (see action items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 credits UI wiring (modal + /credits page + footer link + '?' buttons on ChatIA and MonCompte) is fully functional. Only lingering issue: SEO title on /credits page is not applied by react-helmet-async — verify HelmetProvider setup or global title overrides.
